## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 4-fascicle text by [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Dānapāla is the Northern-Sòng version of the *upāya-kauśalya* (skillful-means) Mahāyāna doctrine, paralleling but distinct from *[Huì shàng pútísà wèn dà shàn quán jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0037)* (T0345). The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Dānapāla's Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau activity (980 – 1017 CE). The Taishō text (T0346) is established on the standard apparatus.
